snippet.title: Breath Bound Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Two divers. One tank. One goal: reach the surface.

Breath Bound is a local 2D co‑op puzzle adventure. You and a partner share a single oxygen tank as you climb through twisting underwater caves. Pass the tank back and forth, push through dense seaweed, and avoid drifting jellyfish. Every decision matters. Move too slowly, get separated, or waste your air and the ocean shows no mercy. The path narrows, the currents shift, and the deeper you go the more the ascent tests your coordination and nerves.

🎮 Wishlist Breath Bound on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3916340/Breath_Bound/

📅 Coming January 16, 2025

🔥 Developed by Fireslug Studios
